lines.en: : That your bike parked outside? The fuck you pay for-
: Wait, what the fuck is my douchebag teacher doing here?! This some kinda intervention?! Cause I ain’t done shit!
: Yeah, I know. He was just telling me about how good your grades are without even having to-
: Hi, Yumi. Nice seeing you here. Anyway, about the apocalypse-
: Why the fuck didn’t you tell me he was gonna be here?
: Welp, there goes that.
: I didn’t know he was gonna be here. But he called and you were takin’ your sweet ass time, so I got bored and invited him over.
: Also, am I actually cute? Just wondering.
: The fuck? Obviously not. You look like you belong in a fucking alleyway surviving off of rats or some shit. Do you have any food?
: Nah. I’ll pick something up tomorrow. You wanna sit?
: Depends. Is Douchebag McDouchefuck staying?
: Ha! Douchebag McDouchefuck. Ain’t she creative?
: I was just leaving actually.
: Bullshit, you’re staying. Need someone to defuse the situation if she snaps and she seems to like you. Or at least as close to likin’ somebody as she can come.
: Since when?! I’d rather chop my pinky off than spend the night hanging out with him!
: Too soon, Yumi. Gary just had to give his up like a week ago. Anyway, you sitting or not?
: Yeah, whatever. Fine. But only cause I ain’t got other shit goin’ on tonight.
: It’ll be great to have you-
: Don’t talk to me.
It’s hard to tell if the progress I’ve recently made with Yumi has gone out the window because of the universe’s mechanics or because she’s in front of her mom.
Which isn’t to say that our progress was substantial by any means. But Yumi has gone out of her way to spend at least one night with me and no pinkies were involved at all.
Also, who is Gary?
: So, you gonna tell me why you’re hangin’ out with my fuckin’ mom when I've told you probably a million times to not do that? Or...
: Well?
: You literally just told me not to talk to you.
: Yuki, the fuck is this guy to you?
: I don’t know. Thought we were just friends until a few minutes ago, but I think he might have the hots for me.
: Don’t be too flattered. He’d fuck a dog if it had a nice wig on.
: That is ridiculous, Yumi. It is perhaps your most absurd accusation yet.
I have no need for an actual dog when I already have Chika to fulfill all of my...dog-related urges.
Which, I’d like to clarify, are a thing I do not have.
Or...didn’t have until recently.
Anyway.
: Or a pony.
: It doesn’t even need a wig either.
: Uhh...what?
: Nothing.
: It would have to be a very nice wig.
: See what I mean? This creep has the hots for literally anything he can stick his tiny dick inside. Inviting him over’s no better than flat-out askin’ to be raped.
: Yo, cut that shit out. Ain’t much I won’t let you joke about, but don’t go sayin’ shit like that rape thing. Know a lot of girls who had to go through that and it ain’t easy.
: Didn’t mean to strike a chord. Just sayin’ he ain’t exactly the most trustworthy person around. It’s a warning. Ain’t startin’ anything.
: Also, let’s get another thing straight. You ain’t letting me joke about anything. I can say whatever the fuck I want, whenever I want and you can’t do shit.
: I can kick you out of my fuckin’ apartment, for one. But other than that, fair.
: Go ahead and kick me out if you want. I’m only here cause I was hungry anyway.
: Sorry to interrupt this incredibly heartfelt interaction, but...since when is this a thing?
: Since when is what a thing? Yumi being hungry? Cause she’s been a fuckin’ bottomless pit since she was an ugly fuckin’ potato.
: Only reason my tits are so small is she sucked the life force out of ‘em when she was a baby.
: Okay, hold up! First off, that is not how tits work! Second, you didn’t even breastfeed me! So don’t go makin’ shit like that up! Specially if it makes me sound gross!
: Ohhh yeah, right. Had so many drugs in my system at the time that I didn’t think it was safe puttin’ you anywhere near my tits. Good memory, Yumi.
: Thank you!
: Again, how long has this been going on?
: I just fucking told you. Forever, dude.
: He’s obviously talking about the two of us speaking again, you stupid bitch! Not how hungry I am!
: Oh, well why the fuck didn’t you just say that? Yumi’s been stoppin’ by for, like...a month or two now?
: We ain’t on good terms or anything. She still wants me to die and I still think she needs to have some sense smacked into her, but we’re aight.
: We’re not aight. I told you I’m only here because I wanted food.

: Yeah, yeah. Food or a couch to crash on — I know. Ain’t gonna hear me bitchin’ about it. Letting you sleep on the couch every once in a while’s the least I can do for spending your whole ass life elsewhere.
: Gee, thanks Yuki. All those years of growing up without a mom are totally worth it now that you’ll let me borrow your grimy-ass, beer-stained couch.
: Hey! At least half of those stains were on the couch when I snagged it off the side of the road! Don’t accuse me of shit I didn’t do!
: I’m...happy for you two?
: Was that a question? Either you’re happy or you’re not. Don’t be a fuckin’ sketch about it.
: I’m just saying it’s nice that you can be in the same room without killing each other. I wasn’t sure if that day would ever come.
: Same here. Kinda fitting though how the thing that brought us together was Yumi getting kicked out of school.
: She’s back now, though. And all it took was a totally sincere apology speech that I’m definitely sure she remembers giving.
: What? What apology speech?
: Didn’t we talk about it during Christmas? How there was some speech that neither one of us-
: The fuck are you talkin’ about? There was no speech. Only reason I made it back into school was because Chika and the class prez vouched for me.
: Makoto? Why would Makoto ever do anything for you?
: Fuck if I know. Probably to get back at Nodoka for beatin’ her ass during the first Dorm War thing.
: Also, I didn’t even fuckin’ talk to you on Christmas. I was babysitting. In fact, I’ve barely seen you at all lately. Kinda peaceful, now that I think about it.
: So all of that stuff with the slumber-
: Sorry, can we go back to why you’re hanging out with Yuki again? Because if you’re trying to fuck my mom, uhh...don’t?
: Yo, don’t tell your teacher who he can and can’t bone. Pretty sure that’s against the rules.
: Thanks, Yuki. But I really wish you would have stepped in when you let her comment on the size of my penis earlier.
: Hey, man. I’m sorry you’re sensitive about the size of your penis or whatever, but if my daughter wants to say some dude has a tiny dick, she can say he has a tiny dick.
: That ain’t even an insult. It’s just a thing we do to remind you that we’re the ones who run this shit. Not you.
: I wish you’d do that in a way that wasn’t inherently hurtful.
: I wish you had a bigger dick so you wouldn’t be crying about this right now.
: Can we not talk about my teacher’s dick?!
: Why? You’re the one who brought it up first. Don’t write a check you can’t cash.

: Oh, did you know you have to go to like a “financial institution” or whatever to cash those? Because I tried doin’ that shit at the convenience store and they looked at me like I was a fucking alien.
: That’s probably the only useful piece of information I’ve ever heard from you.
: All that’s left now is to find an actual job, I guess.
: I’ve been tellin’ you, come work at the fuckin’ bar. Sara needs the help with shit gettin’ kinda busy now.
: And be around you for more than one hour a day? I’m good. I’d rather clean toilets or some shit.
: Even better. None of us like cleaning the toilets so we can just leave that to you.
: Yumi, do you really not remember anything about-
: I don’t know, Yuki...your boss seemed really fucking annoying. And I’m pretty sure her daughter is terrified of me.
: Oh, fuck yeah she is. But that’s cause you’re my daughter and intimidating people is just in our blood or whatever. But it’s no big deal.
: Just give it some thought. If somebody like me is able to make enough to find a place to live, you’d probably be able to make even more.
: Plus, I can tell you now that the women who come to that place are fucking deprived and those tits are gonna get people in the doors.
: I already dragged in all the girls who want to be dominated or beat up or whatever. You can handle the rest. Learn how to behave and you’ll probably land even more.
: Ew! Fucking ew! I’m not going to work somewhere where I just get hit on all day!
: Why not? They seem to like it when you’re mean to them.
: I think that might just be a you thing, Yuki.
: That your thing too? Because if you want me to be mean to you, I can just do it. We ain’t gotta make out first.
: Okay, I’m out. Any more of this and I’m going to fucking puke.
: Nah, nah. Hold up a sec. I’ll kick this fucker out in a minute.
: You will?
: There’s just something I wanna talk to him about first.
: And I am needed here...why?
: You’re hungry, ain’t you? I’ll order a pizza or whatever. Just chill inside while I go talk to Douchebag McDouchefuck. Grab a beer for all I care. I don’t give a shit.
: I really hope that nickname doesn’t stick. Your family renames me too often and that is especially annoying now that I know my-
: You realize I’m underage, right? I can’t drink.
: Since when do you give a shit about the law? You steal TVs and had no problem buying me cigarettes the other day.
: Okay, fine. Beer just kinda tastes like shit. I’ll grab a water, though.
: Oh, and if he comes back in here with you, I’m out. Ain’t got time to watch you two be all buddy-buddy and shit all night.
: Got it.
: Come on, McDouchefuck. Me and you are gonna have a little chat.
: It’s “You and I.”
: What?
: You said “me and you are going to have a little chat” when it should be “You and I are going to have a little chat.”
: Do you want to keep your balls?
: I would prefer them to remain attached to my body, yes.
: Cool. Then don’t correct me like that. I know I’m a fucking idiot, but it’s annoying when people just remind me.
: Gotcha...So, about what happened in there...
: What about it?
: Isn’t that...what you wanted to talk about?
: You mean about the thing with you wanting to hook up with me? Nah. That ain’t got shit to do with this.
: Surprised the fuck out of me, though. Figured you were just messing around this whole time.
: I also think it’s a shit idea for the two of us to go down that path since I’ll only wind up draggin’ you into my never-ending sob story, but that ain’t what I wanted to talk about.
: Then what-
: I want to know what the fuck happened with Yumi and that Nodoka girl. She won’t tell me shit.
: I was fine with that at first, but the more I think about it, the more fucked up I’m getting.
: I didn’t teach her much, we all know that, but I know damn well she wouldn’t fuck someone up that bad unless she had a reason to.
: And what makes you think I know that reason?
: She told me.
: Oh.
: Well yeah, that’s pretty damning.
: The fuck you have to gain from hiding it? Ain’t like I’m gonna do anything. I just want to know what the fuck is going on.
: This isn’t really something I should let myself get dragged any further into. If Yumi can tell you that I know what’s going on, she can definitely tell you what happened herself.
: Just because she’s sleeping on my couch and eating my TV dinners doesn’t mean she’s gonna just spill her heart out to me.
: Doubt we’ll ever get to that level after the shit we’ve been through. But I’m still gonna worry about her.
: And...I don’t want to say I deserve to know what’s going on in her life, but...
: Uhh...hello? The hell are you doing here? You can’t just come all the way to my apartment complex and then only hang out with my neighbors.
: I’ll admit that I’ve heard your voice in my head on several occasions, but I seriously thought I was going insane tonight with how much of it I heard. You’ve got some explaining to do.
: Friend of yours?
: Subordinate.
: Subordinate?!
: Is that all I am to you? Because I’m all about power dynamics, Senpai, but not like this!
: Surprise. I’m here because I missed you.
: I was just the appetizer. He’s all yours now...whatever your name is.
: Imani Imai. Nice to finally meet you, intimidating onee-san in the room next to mine.
: Yuki Yamaguchi. Think I gave you a beer during that weird ass contest thing you guys had at Sakaki-bar-a. Nice to actually meet you for real this time.
: You know, I knew I recognized you from somewhere and-
: Sorry, did you say “Yamaguchi?”
: Yup.
: Welp, that certainly explains the other familiar auditory hallucination I just had as well. Glad that mystery is over and done with.
: Are you going somewhere?
: My boyfriend’s house.
: Cool. Have fun.
: He doesn’t mean that. We’re closer than this. Oh, Senpai. You’re so funny.
: She’s probably just going to the bar to meet up with some of our other friends. We do that sometimes.
: Really? Only saw her there the one time, I think. Maybe two, but that’s pushing it.
: Not your bar. Another bar.
: Another bar?! You’re cheating on us?
: I can explain.
: Sara’s heart’s gonna fuckin’ shatter.
: Then don’t tell her.
: Senpai, just out of curiosity, is there any woman in Kumon-mi that you are not having sex with?
: Yes, but not for long.
: I really worry about you sometimes.
: Uhh...anyway, sorry Imani, but this guy and I were in the middle of a pretty private conversation and...you’re gonna have to get the fuck out of here.
: Understood! I’ll go be jealous somewhere else! But, should you ever find yourself without anything to do, you should join us at that dive around the corner! That’s our spot now.
: How cool is that? We have a spot. We’re a group of friends with a spot. I’m finally popular after all these years!
: It’s time to leave, Imani.
: You’re going to appreciate me one day. Mark my words, Senpai.
: I would appreciate you more off-screen.
: God, is this really what Makoto’s been dealing with all year long?! Why are you so mean to the people who help you the most?!
: Are you two-
: No. Not yet at least. We’re just friends.
: Gotcha...
: Anyway, about the Yumi thing-
: Let’s...take a rain check on the Yumi thing. I’ll see if I can get any more out of her since I know you ain’t gonna tell me shit.
: Go join your friend at the bar. Seemed nice. And a lot closer to your age than a certain someone you almost made the mistake of kissing tonight.
: It wouldn’t have been a mistake.
: It would have. But it’s cool. Sometimes people get caught up in the moment or whatever. Ain’t gonna hold it against you.

: But, before you go telling me I’m wrong again, do me a favor and get the fuck out of here. Yumi’s gonna bail if I stay outside any longer and the cheapest pizza place around is gonna be closing soon.
: You sure you don’t want to come to the bar as well? One of the girls is both older and more heavily tattooed than you.
: Oooh, tempting. She have an unruly daughter as well?
: If by “unruly” you mean “impulsive and horny” then yes.
: Maybe some other time. Secretly, of course.
: Got somethin’ else I should be doin’ right now. Would be an idiot to walk away from that again, even if it is temporary.
: I’m proud of you, Yuki.
: You’re doing well.
: Save it for the next girl you try to seduce, won’t ya? Got at least one both older and more heavily tattooed than me waiting for you right now.
: Yeah...but she’s kind of...
: Uhh...
: I’ll just...wait until you meet her.
Yuki heads back into her apartment as I make my way down the stairs.
Seeing as I am now abandoning my original plans and heading to the dive bar instead, I send Imani a text and manage to catch up with her just before she heads inside.
I hope that everything went well with the Yamaguchis, but I guess I probably won’t know that until the next time I’m able to see Yuki.
It’s strange, though. I remember Yumi saying something about how she spoke to her mom, but...I don’t think it was at this level prior to the last reset.
This has to be some sort of aftereffect from that, doesn’t it?
I guess I’ll just have to...keep an eye out.
Because as nice as it is that the two of them were able to grow a little closer without me around-
I am frightened by the idea of anyone progressing without me.
I want to be there for the ups and down.
I want to watch the world move.
Yuki’s affection has increased to [yuki_love]!
Imani’s affection has increased to [imani_love]!
